name: Halberd Elite
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 225 leadership · T4
pitch: A shield-line shredder that ignores block and demands the front lane, with the staying power to punish grouped enemies. Recently buffed on cooldown and armour penetration, but needs support — the 30% mitigation window from ability 2 is its only defence.
